reasoning: The image shows a banana leaf with a single oval lesion featuring a very dark (near-black) necrotic center surrounded by a distinct yellowish-orange/tan halo against otherwise healthy green tissue. This pattern — isolated dark spot with a lighter halo on a banana leaf — is characteristic of Cordana Leaf Spot (Cordana musae). Cigar End Rot affects fruit tips, Panama Disease causes systemic wilting, Bunchy Top causes viral stunting, and Sigatoka typically shows elongated streaks rather than isolated focal spots.
